schemes.title: Tripura Public Service Commission Recruitment
schemes.brief: The Tripura Public Service Commission recruits for the state civil service and for the gazetted and technical posts of the state departments. Every advertisement is applied for through its online recruitment application system.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every TPSC advertisement, with admit cards and results
eligibility: Indian citizen who is ordinarily a resident of Tripura for the posts that require it
Age as the advertisement states, usually 18 to 40, with relaxation for SC, ST, OBC and disability
The qualification the advertisement requires, complete on its closing date
Knowledge of Bengali or Kokborok as some advertisements specify
documents: Madhyamik (Class 10) certificate for date of birth
Tripura caste or tribe certificate, for a reserved category
Disability or ex-serviceman certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Advertisement and post applied for
demoFields.value: Advt 09 of 2026 — Tripura Civil Service Grade II
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Read the qualification and age limit there before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Madhyamik certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Madhyamik certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Madhyamik certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Madhyamik certificate. Age limits count from this date.

demoFields.label: Category claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Tripura certificate for. A certificate from another state is not accepted for the reservation.

demoFields.label: Permanent Residence Certificate number
demoFields.hint: Required for most Tripura state posts. Get it from e-District before the closing date.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the advertisement's closing date.

demoFields.label: Examination centre preference
demoFields.hint: Give a choice where the advertisement asks for one.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here.

demoSteps: Get the permanent residence certificate and the caste or tribe certificate from e-District before the closing date. Most rejections are for want of these.
Register on tpsc.onlinetripura.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Madhyamik certificate.
Open the advertisement, apply through the same login, upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee.
Print the filled application and keep it with the payment receipt until the recruitment ends.
Download the admit card from the same login and take it with a photo ID.
Results are published on the Commission's site. Document verification is last, where the originals of everything claimed must be produced.

schemes.title: Meghalaya Online — Certificates and e-Services
schemes.brief: Meghalaya Online is the state's single window for certificates and departmental services — income, Scheduled Tribe, residence, trading and other certificates, applied for online and downloaded from the same account.
schemes.benefit: Income, Scheduled Tribe and residence certificates applied for online
eligibility: Resident of Meghalaya, applying in the district where the family lives
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued for the tribes notified for Meghalaya — Khasi, Jaintia and Garo among them
A residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Father's Scheduled Tribe certificate, for a tribe certificate
Certificate from the Headman or the village Dorbar
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, Scheduled Tribe, residence, trading or a departmental service. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: Meghalaya's Khasi and Garo societies are matrilineal, so the form may ask for the mother's name. Fill whichever the form asks for.

demoFields.label: Tribe claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the list notified for Meghalaya. A tribe notified in another state does not qualify here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Village or Locality
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Deputy Commissioner of this district issues the certificate.

demoFields.label: Headman or Dorbar certificate
demoFields.value: Rangbah Shnong, Nongthymmai — signed and stamped
demoFields.hint: Most Meghalaya certificates need the Headman's or the Dorbar's certificate. Get it before you apply, not after.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the certificate from your Headman or village Dorbar first. Nearly every Meghalaya certificate is issued on the strength of it.
Register on meghalayaonline.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre.
Choose the certificate and fill the form from your Aadhaar and the Headman's certificate.
Upload the documents, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The block staff verify the family, then the Deputy Commissioner's office issues the certificate.
Download it from the same login and check the tribe name and the parent's name before relying on it.
schemes.helpline: Your Deputy Commissioner's office, or the block office of your area

schemes.title: Meghalaya e-District Citizen Services
schemes.brief: Meghalaya's e-District portal handles the district administration's own services — registrations, permissions, licences and the status of applications made at the Deputy Commissioner's office, without going there in person.
schemes.benefit: District administration registrations, permissions and application status online
eligibility: Resident of Meghalaya, or a business operating in the state
The application must fall within the district administration's own services
A mobile number for the OTP and the application number
Some services need the Headman's or the Dorbar's certificate first
documents: Address proof for the premises or the residence
Headman or Dorbar certificate, where the service requires it
Supporting papers the particular service asks for

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Pick the department first, then the service. The list shows what the district administration handles online.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: The district whose Deputy Commissioner's office handles the service.

demoFields.label: Application Number
demoFields.hint: Given on the acknowledgement when the application was filed. It is how the status is looked up.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.hint: Where you live, or where the premises are for a business service.

demoFields.label: Supporting document
demoFields.hint: Many services need it. Upload a clear scan.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and every status change come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Open megedistrict.gov.in and pick the department and the service you need.
Register with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre if the connection at home is poor.
Fill the form, upload Aadhaar, the address proof and whatever the service asks for, and pay any fee.
Note the application number from the acknowledgement. Every follow-up runs on it.
Track the status on the same portal rather than travelling to the Deputy Commissioner's office.
Download the approval or the certificate when it is issued, and check the details before relying on it.
